topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and contextualises it within the course.

topics.label: Molecular Sensing of Pathogens and Tissue Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies microbial presence and tissue injury through pattern recognition receptors and danger-signaling pathways.

topics.label: Cellular Activation, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Systemic Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate the inflammatory response, guiding leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic drainage, and potential systemic complications such as septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how acute inflammation is terminated, how tissue is repaired, and how unresolved or persistent responses give rise to chronic inflammation and granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing statement and previews the subject of the next lecture.
